meta.name: reconciliation
meta.description: Match bank transactions to invoices and surface unpaid / unmatched items in a Well workspace. Use when the user asks what's paid vs unpaid, to reconcile the bank, to find missing payments, or to match transactions to invoices.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动匹配银行交易与发票，找出未付或未匹配项
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要核对银行流水与发票，追踪未付款项
copy.tagline_en: Match bank transactions to invoices and surface unpaid items
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to reconcile bank transactions with invoices and track unpaid items

howto.what: 当用户询问对账或付款状态时，Claude 会查询 Well 工作区中的银行交易和发票，报告已匹配、未支付和未解释的交易，并提供每个类别的计数和总额。
howto.when: 当用户询问哪些已支付或未支付、要求对账、查找缺失付款或匹配交易与发票时触发。

say.text: 帮我核对上个月的银行交易和发票。
say.note: 列出已匹配、未支付和未解释的交易。

say.text: 找出所有未支付的发票。
say.note: 按到期日或金额排序显示。

say.text: 列出与发票不匹配的银行交易。
say.note: 显示需要人工审查的交易。

howto.what_en: Claude connects bank transactions and invoices in a Well workspace, reporting matched, unpaid, and unexplained items with counts and totals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about paid vs unpaid, requests reconciliation, finds missing payments, or matches transactions to invoices.

say_en.text: Reconcile last month's bank transactions with invoices.
say_en.note: Displays matched, unpaid, and unexplained items.
Sorted by due date or amount.

say_en.text: List bank transactions not linked to any invoice.
